prompt: A continuous cinematic first-person shot, six seconds. Start exactly from this nearly closed walnut door and its narrow amber sliver. Hold for 0.5 seconds. The same solid door slowly rotates inward on its LEFT hinges; the brass handle stays attached and travels leftward and away. Reveal a warm modern private club: brown leather sofa, red cushions, amber lamps, rainy city window, and an adult dark-haired man standing at the right in a black rolled-sleeve shirt and loose tie. Gently dolly forward only after the door is sufficiently open. Consistent wooden panels, door frame and wall lamp throughout; subtle ambient light movement. Natural physical opening, one uninterrupted take. NO viewer hands, arms, body or reflection. No touching, teleportation, dissolves, morphing architecture, portals, new doors, foreground people, text or logos.
